question.text: Can a depository directly open accounts and provide services to clients?

answer.text: No, it must operate through Depository Participants
Yes, it can directly open accounts for all types of investors
Yes, but only for institutional investors
Yes, but only for foreign portfolio investors

explanation.text: The Logic: A depository cannot directly open accounts and provide services to clients. Any person avails depository services by opening a demat account through a DP. The Trap: Carve-outs for institutional or foreign portfolio investors are incorrect — the depository serves all client types through DPs. Note: Depositories serve clients exclusively through Depository Participants.
